sections.title: Inputs And Prerequisites
sections.text: Input is {} only; no study, solver, license or workspace fields. Shared CAD context still requires an explicitly named unique open document with a Design product (optional project ID can disambiguate saved documents). This operation imports adsk.sim and reads class metadata only. No Simulation/Study construction, Simulations.get, product access, entitlement call, workspace activation, meshing, solving or results retrieval occurs.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: Normal command envelope contains success:boolean,operation:string,document:string,result:object,created:[]; result contains profile:stable-distributed,module:adsk.sim,moduleAvailable:boolean,importError:string|null,classes:row[5],stableFEASolve:{available:false,status:unavailable in supported profile},entitlement:notChecked,productAccessed:false,limitations:string[],nativeExamples:[{operation:string,data:object}]. Each class row has name:string,available:boolean,preview:true,runtimeDocMarksPreview:boolean,statusSource:string,supported:false. Class names in order are Simulations,SimulationModel,SimulationModels,Studies,Study. statusSource is runtime documentation when its docstring includes preview (case-insensitive), otherwise known SDK specification (September 2026). Import exceptions become importError with exception type/message and moduleAvailable:false; this is a successful discovery result, not proof of license failure. Missing classes are still represented, not omitted.

sections.title: Interpretation And Discovery
sections.text: No solver/study IDs or tokens are discovered because no supported solver operation exists in this family. Module availability is not solve support, stability or entitlement evidence. Preview status remains true even if runtime docs are absent. nativeExamples are explanatory templates, not executed or guaranteed-ready requests: their motion.sample joint-token must be replaced with result.joint from real joint creation or a joint selected and discovered through selection.inspect result.selections[0].entity. Inspect that joint's native ownership, DOFs and limits before sampling. Kinematic motion.sample is not FEA/dynamics. Runtime SDK exposure is live-only observation; offline tests assert metadata behavior without accessing Fusion.

examples.label: Discover supported profile metadata
examples.requires: Explicitly scoped open Fusion Design document. No simulation workspace, study, license query, or token prerequisite.
examples.output: result.moduleAvailable and importError describe import; result.stableFEASolve.available remains false and entitlement is notChecked.
